server: LabServer63 (main; user 2026-11-04: take the server without waiting for other jobs); root ~/rest_src73; ~/rest_repr68, ~/rest_cover71, ~/rest_cmp72, ~/rest_drift_smoke are read-only inputs

contexts.INT: top/bottom (faces 4/5), both in-plane edge distances >= 10 mm
contexts.TBE: top/bottom, nearest in-plane edge < 10 mm, farther >= 10 mm (edge band)
contexts.TBC: top/bottom, both in-plane edge distances < 10 mm (corner zone)
contexts.SM: side face, |z| = 1.25 mm row, along-edge distance to the vertical slab edge >= 10 mm
contexts.SR: side face, |z| = 3.75 mm row (adjacent to the top/bottom edge), along-edge >= 10 mm
contexts.SV: side face, along-edge distance to the vertical slab edge < 10 mm

geometry.images: exact rest symmetries D4 x z-flip (sym72.ops(True), 16 permutations incl. identity); every distance is 3-D rest distance in mm

removal.rule: flat-interior S16 sources (context INT and rest-xy distance from the pt0 dent centre >= pt0 radius + 10 mm, so the source's 1 cm neighbourhood is undeformed in both training geometries) that are exact rest-symmetry images of another flat-interior S16 source; remove all but the lowest slot of each such orbit; the rule must remove exactly 4 sources or the design is infeasible (STOP). The removed sources are exact duplicates of slot 2 at REST only: at pt0 they sit at different positions relative to the dent and the response covers every receiver, so their pt0 supervision is distinct for D1, A and B alike (A's pt0 symmetry images go to the pt0 variant geometries; only the asw image fixes pt0). The removal cost is measured by REM_NEAR (decision) and TRAIN_REMOVED_rest/pt0 (descriptive; in-sample for the S16 models)

stage0.replacement_rule: on the slot's face and context, ports ordered by (3-D rest distance to target rounded 1e-6 mm, index); first admissible: not an exact image of any previously referenced port (WL66/68/71 slots 0-15 and 20-27, WL72 slots 40-47) or of an already chosen replacement, and min over bins of (1-beta) >= 0.5 at rest and pt0 (archived geometries); no reselection. Targets sit 31.25 mm from the face centre along the edge so that a mid-edge region ~30 mm from every image of the new sources remains for 'far' confirmation and a 5 mm 'near' position exists
stage0.confirmation_rule: in slot order; candidates = ports of the slot's context (and face / edge row / side row filters), not an exact image of any previously referenced port, of any S16-R source or of an already chosen confirmation port, min over bins (1-beta) >= 0.5 at rest; at least 10 mm (3-D) from every already chosen static confirmation port (decorrelation); dA = 3-D distance to the nearest actual S16-R training port, dI = to the nearest exact image of an S16-R training port; 'near' = minimise |dA - 5 mm| (so near for every architecture, with or without symmetry), 'far' = maximise dI (far from every image, hence from every actual port); ties by port index; no reselection. INT is restricted to edge distance >= 21.25 mm (the S16 support range); TBE to the 1.25 mm edge row (the S16-R TBE source row) 'near_removed' (slots 76-79): on the removed source's face, minimise |distance to that actual removed S16 source - 5 mm| (same exclusions, so never an image of slot 2 or of any training port). Second 'far' ports (90-92) for TBE, SM and SR follow the far rule after all earlier choices (the 10 mm spacing moves them to another mid-edge); the TBC corner zone is too small for a second far port.

deformation_pose.rule: among in-family WL57 poses never used for a port-probe reference and not WL59 training poses (tr00-tr11), choose the one whose dent centre is farthest from every exact D4 image of the probed dented poses' centres; ties: larger radius, then name
deformation_pose.archived_geometry: LabServer69:~/rest_wl57/data/geometry/te0.pt sha256 792164100e01f6932747f4a57302c24845fbdf47bd2f6c4407e92a98dc60c667, copied to ~/rest_src73/inputs/geometry_te0.pt; identity gate vs a fresh LabServer63 build: KEYS bitwise except node |delta| <= 1e-12 (WL72 amendment 1); beta is the archived one throughout

footprint.rule: ports on the slot face with rest-xy distance from the te0 dent centre <= 0.6 R (b >= 0.35, top dz >= 1.7 mm), ordered by (3-D distance to target, index); first admissible: not an exact image of any referenced, S16-R or already chosen confirmation port; min (1-beta) >= 0.5 at rest and te0

frozen.note: exact lists produced by the Stage 0 rules (ports73.py propose on the LabServer63 archived geometries, 2026-11-04), frozen before any new reference, fit or evaluation; ports73.py freeze recomputes them in the chain and stops on any difference (revised 2026-11-04 before freezing, after the pre-freeze design review: strata 76-79 and 90-92 added)

references.estimator: unchanged WL66/68/71/72: tagged first-exit action (tag_reference.tagged_action) of the unchanged WL57 fast walker (r57_fastwalk; the WL72A engine is NOT used), one-hot probe (port, incoming bin) with unit flux in all channels, packet gates probes68.gates, 32M photons, 32M chunk with 16M OOM fallback from the packet's own seed (probes72.trace)

training.budget: identical to every S16 slot: 16 sources x 4 fitting replicas x 32M photons per (geometry, bin); the 12 retained sources reuse their archived WL66/68/71 bundles unchanged

references.seeds: training 733000000 + g*1e6 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep (rest 0, pt0 1); confirmation 736000000 + g*1e6 + ... (rest 0, te0 1); unique; disjoint from WL66-72
references.machine: LabServer63 (as the WL68/71/72 references; slots 0-3 were traced on LabServer69 in WL66 and passed the WL68 cross-machine gate)

optimizer.algorithm: Adam (0.9, 0.999, 1e-8), full batch, float32, TF32 off, 4 CPU threads
optimizer.convergence: WL68 last-decile rule (<1 %) on the optimised loss

run_rule: every run uses the WL71/WL72 constructor of its family unchanged (fit72.model_for: D1/A = fit71.model_from(P_590x) with the net_all_5902 A/O, 'net' group; B = rsk72.RSK from torch.manual_seed(seed)), the WL68 objective J (fit71.objective, mean over rest and pt0), A's L_sym exactly as WL72 (fit72.sym_data on the S16-R labels, lambda 1) and the optimiser above; D1 differs from A only by lambda_sym = 0 (WL71's D1 used the same objective through fit71.run)

stage1.rule: before any new reference: (1) eval73 reproduces WL72's archived pooled upper bounds (every metric and channel) for the six historical models on S16_rest/pt0, FIN71_rest/cf2, H3_cf3, CONF72_rest/te2 and DEF71 within eval_rel_tol; (2) a 500-step replay of D1_5901 / A_5901 / B_7201 on S16 through the WL73 training path reproduces the archived initial objective within initial_rel_tol and the archived logged J trajectory (steps 0-475, historical 20k schedule) within trajectory_rel_tol (float32 GPU reductions are not bitwise reproducible); any failure stops the batch. Replays are controls, never candidates

precision.rule: eval72 sigSE per matrix (coarse signal/SE, worst channel); groups use qualified matrices only; fewer than 4 -> UNMEASURED

groups.TRAIN_NEW: S16-R replacement sources 50-53 (rest, pt0; replicas 4-7): training fit of the new support (4 matrices per geometry; abs signal/SE was >= 1.5e4 for every historical matrix, so qualification is not expected to bind; if it does, the batch is INCONCLUSIVE)
groups.BND: static confirmation in the newly supported boundary contexts (TBE, TBC, SM, SR; slots 64-71, 90-92, rest)
groups.BND_NEAR: primary: slots 64, 66, 68, 70 (5 mm from an actual new source; local interpolation)
groups.BND_FAR: primary: slots 65, 67, 69, 71, 90, 91, 92 (farthest from every image of an S16-R source; transfer)
groups.UNS: side vertical-edge context (slots 72-75, rest): no source in that context in either population, but adjacent to the images of the new TBC source; descriptive, not a support-specificity control
groups.INT_ALL: primary regression group: interior static confirmation (INT_DED slots 60-63 + FP_rest slots 80-85, rest); the six footprint ports are clustered (no spacing rule), INT_DED and FP_rest are also reported separately
groups.DEF73: te0 - rest on slots 80-85 (signed geometry change; >= 4 qualified matrices or UNMEASURED; reported separately). te0 overlaps the pt0 training dent (centre offset 7.07 mm, R 20 vs 22.5 mm, depth 5 vs 5.75 mm): DEF73 is a near-training-pose interpolation check, not a test of transfer to new deformations, and S16 vs S16-R differences in DEF73 are not attributed to boundary support
groups.development: S16_rest/pt0, FIN71_rest/cf2, H3_cf3, CONF72_rest/te2 (WL72 confirmation, now development), DEF71 (cf2), CONFDEF72 (te2): labelled development evidence
groups.REM_NEAR: primary regression group for the removal cost: slots 76-79, 5 mm from the actual removed S16 sources (held out for every model)

decision.metrics: w(model, group, m) = worst-channel upper 95 % bound (eval68 pooled, jackknife, t(K-1)) for m in {con_coarse, abs_coarse}
decision.per_architecture: for X in {D1, A, B}, S16 seeds (WL71/72 finals) vs S16-R seeds (WL73 finals): valid = implementation/passivity gates pass for all four models; fit_ok = (WL59 quality gates Q pass on TRAIN_NEW_rest and TRAIN_NEW_pt0 for both S16-R seeds) OR (relative fit: for both S16-R seeds, both geometries and both m, w(TRAIN_NEW) <= 1.25 w(TRAIN_KEEP) of the same model) - the deciding basis is reported; no_deficit = every S16 seed already passes Q on BND_FAR; far = better(BND_FAR); near = better(BND_NEAR); accurate = Q passes on BND_FAR for both S16-R seeds; regression = worse(INT_ALL) or worse(REM_NEAR)
decision.classes: not valid -> INCONCLUSIVE; not fit_ok -> INSUFFICIENT FIT; no_deficit -> NO SUPPORT DEFICIT; far OVERLAP -> INCONCLUSIVE (seed variance); far YES: regression YES -> TRADE-OFF / REDISTRIBUTION, else accurate -> SUPPORT-SENSITIVE GENERALIZATION, else SUPPORT-SENSITIVE GENERALIZATION (partial) + SUPPORT INSUFFICIENT (accuracy); far NO and near YES -> SUPPORT-SENSITIVE (local only) + SUPPORT INSUFFICIENT (transfer) (+ TRADE-OFF if regression YES); far NO and near not YES -> SUPPORT INSUFFICIENT (+ TRADE-OFF if regression YES); a regression OVERLAP adds 'possible regression (seed overlap)'; any primary group (BND_FAR, BND_NEAR, INT_ALL, REM_NEAR, TRAIN_NEW_rest/pt0, TRAIN_KEEP_rest/pt0) UNMEASURED, a failed Stage 1 gate, a reference gate failure or detected leakage -> INCONCLUSIVE
decision.interpretation_mapping: per architecture: SUPPORT-SENSITIVE GENERALIZATION (accurate) -> consistent with missing training support; partial -> mixed (support helps, representation still limits accuracy); local only or SUPPORT INSUFFICIENT with fit_ok -> insufficient transfer within represented boundary conditions (H_mapping); TRADE-OFF -> distribution trade-off; INSUFFICIENT FIT, NO SUPPORT DEFICIT or INCONCLUSIVE -> unresolved for that architecture; disagreement between architectures -> mixed distribution / representation effect
decision.cross_architecture: same budget (S16-R): X ranked above Y on BND_FAR iff better(BND_FAR) with X as 'new' and Y as 'old' is YES; descriptive, not an adoption decision
decision.deformation: DEF73 reported per model (Q_def: abs_coarse upper <= 0.35 and corr >= 0.90 per channel) and S16 vs S16-R, separately from the static endpoints; UNMEASURED if fewer than 4 matrices qualify
decision.descriptive: BND_NEAR, BND_FAR, UNS, INT_DED, FP_rest, FP_te0, TRAIN_KEEP, TRAIN_REMOVED, development groups, per-source rows with distances to S16 / S16-R (actual and images), model vs physical flux profiles (5/10/20/40 mm), checkpoints @2000/@6000/@10000 (drift; never selected), WL59 extended fields, passivity, labelled fixed-A/O oracle (BND_NEAR, BND_FAR, UNS, INT_DED, REM_NEAR, TRAIN_NEW_rest), cost
decision.comparisons: three-valued with f = 0.8 and g = 1.25 over the two seeds per condition: better(G) = YES if for both m max_new w(G) <= f min_old w(G); NO if for some m min_new w(G) > f max_old w(G); otherwise OVERLAP (seed variance). worse(G) = YES if for some m min_new w(G) >= g max_old w(G); NO if for both m max_new w(G) < g min_old w(G); otherwise OVERLAP
decision.confounds: removal is not information-neutral for any architecture at pt0 and is neutral at rest only for A (exact images through slot 2) and approximately for the position-free B; D1-vs-A differences are therefore not pure support-transfer differences. Source location and boundary context are crossed at different attainable distances (TBC far is 8.75 mm from both edges; INT far dI is 10.3 mm). te0 is close to the training pose pt0 (see DEF73)

prohibited: tuning lambda, learning rates or thresholds
